title: Lab - Verify integrity and availability of resources and key processes
description: Check disk, memory and services, and repair a filesystem.
scenario: Check disk, memory and services, and repair a filesystem. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Space
tasks.instructions: Which filesystem is fullest, and which directory under /var uses the most space?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Memory
tasks.instructions: How much memory is actually available, as opposed to free?

tasks.title: Task 3 - fsck
tasks.instructions: Check an unmounted ext4 filesystem for errors.
